blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Motorists traversing the congested Banilad-Talamban corridor will have new routes into and out of Cebu IT Park starting November 27. The change comes as Cebu City reverses the traffic flow along Road 15 to prevent vehicles exiting the business park from disrupting traffic along Gov. Cuenco Avenue. The Cebu City Transportation Office (CCTO) will initially implement the adjustment through a dry run beginning at midnight on Friday, November 27, Assistant Department Head Kent Jongoy announced during a forum with Mayor Nestor Archival on Wednesday, November 25.
